question: Which among the following dance forms is not related to Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is **Rauf**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Rauf and Hikat is a folk dance associated with the state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Apart from this, other folk dances of Jammu and Kashmir include Damali, Hikat, Mandjas, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information:__ Huttari:

__
 
• Huttari dance is a folk dance done mainly by Kodavas in Kodagu.
 
• The dance is performed by wearing Kodava outfit with fancy knives.
 
• It is a harvest festival celebrated during November or December.

Suggi:

 
• Suggi dance is also a harvesting festival in Karnataka.
 
• It is mainly performed by Halakki Tribe.

Yakshagana:

 
• Yakshagana is a folk theatre form of Karnataka.
 
• It is popular in coastal districts of Dakshina Kannada, Udupi and Ittara Kannada of Karnataka 
 
• The dance is performed during the night after winter crop harvestation.

Other folk dances of Karnataka: 

 
• Dollu Kunita
 
• Togalu Gombeyata
 
• Karaga
 
• Veeragaase
 
• Kamsale
 
• Goravara Kunita etc.
